section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the joy of Rosh Hashanah comes from drawing down a supernal light through judgment, and that the standing of all Israel ensures this light is drawn down.
section.t: And this is: “Let the field exult and all that is in it,”
meaning that through the judgment and justice of Rosh Hashanah, a most supernal light is drawn down.
And this is also what they said in the Midrash,
brought in the Tur, Laws of Rosh Hashanah:
“This nation knows the character of its God—
for all the nations wrap themselves in black and wear black,
but Israel wears white and wraps themselves in white,
because they know that the Holy One, blessed be He, will perform a miracle for them.”
For at first glance it is not understood: what is the joy of wearing white?
For even though they know that He will perform a miracle for them,
nevertheless,
would it not be better that there be no judgment at all?
But the explanation is,
that the judgment of Rosh Hashanah is for the sake of drawing down a more supernal light,
and therefore there is joy.
And this is what is meant by “He will perform a miracle for them,”
for a miracle is above nature,
meaning a light that is above the chain of descent (hishtalshelus).
For “this day is the beginning of Your works,”
for Malchus is included in the aspect of “the King elevated alone from then,”
the aspect of His Name in the aspect of “He alone is He,”
and from there one must draw down.
However, since a most supernal light is drawn down,
there are accusers that the light should not be drawn down,
therefore He says,
“You are standing today, all of you, before Havayah,”
meaning all the levels within the souls of Israel—
“your heads, your tribes,” etc., meaning those of comprehension whose service is in the manner of the service of the Seraphim,
“from the hewer of your wood to the drawer of your water,” whose service is in acceptance of the yoke in the manner of the service of the Ofanim—
behold, all the levels stand firm and endure and prevail in judgment,
so that the supernal light will be drawn down to them,
“before Havayah,”
above the level of the Name Havayah,
and this is drawn down below, down into this world, in all the matters of the judgment and justice of Rosh Hashanah,
that there should be a healthy year, a living year, and a joyful year in all particulars,
and in children, life, and sustenance in abundance.
